game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Ore Smelter Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap. Each round, a new heat shields challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the predictions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 600 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
